name: 小鹅通直播护航
description_zh: 实时守护小鹅通平台直播状态，帮助商家快速发现推流异常、卡顿、在线波动等问题。支持开播检查、直播监控和播后复盘，保障直播稳定进行。
description_en: Monitors live stream status on the xiaoe platform in real time, helping merchants quickly detect issues such as push failures, lag, and fluctuating viewership. Supports pre-broadcast checks, live monitoring, and post-broadcast review to ensure stable streaming.
